forensic_summary.trigger: Catastrophic yield collapse in Mass Production. Total RTY (Rolling Throughput Yield) plummeted to 35.40% in Week 10. The optical engine was sieged by 'impurities' (dust/particles), specifically 91 units (41%) failing for DMD dust.
forensic_summary.intervention: Implementation of a rigorous 'Cleanroom' protocol and specific optical inspection stations (O4/O7). Engineers were forced to manually 'wipe DMD clean' under 20x magnification microscopes. A 'Blue dot' defect required investigating the diffuser injection molding process.
forensic_summary.result: Yield recovery was slow and painful. By Week 16, Cleanroom RTY crawled to 70.97%, but total yield remained volatile, hitting 0.00% in Weeks 15 and 29.
